text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Vivlos talking with 
Mejiro Dober in the gym—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: You'll be totally fine, go on in~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'll ask for now! Right? We don't even 
know if it's a bother yet!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Y... Yeah. For now... for now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's the matter, Dober? You're 
acting all formal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's okay... I won't know unless I ask. 
...I'll never know unless I ask...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um... S-So... I was just wondering what 
Ryan's plans are for today..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um... if your schedule allows... Could you 
teach me some strength training...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wah! Of course, with pleasure!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"It's not every day Dober asks for a 
favor, so I want her to rely on me without 
holding back!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...! ...Th-Thank you...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh♪ Good girl, Dober-san♪
choice_data_list:
(I wonder if she was giving someone 
advice…?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On another day, while spending time with 
Vivlos near the hollow of the great tree—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos-san...! Thank you so much for the 
other day!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Flower! How did it go? Were you able to be 
properly spoiled?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! Just as Vivlos-san advised—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I love and respect you, Sky-san, and I 
want to train alongside you!" ...Tell her 
your honest feelings like that!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And then, it was arranged that we'd get to 
do regular training runs together!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to you, Vivlos-san. Thank 
you so much!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm♡ Go ahead and pamper yourself as 
much as you want from now on~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It looks like Viblos is teaching her 
how to be expertly pampered. Even after 
this, I saw similar exchanges quite often—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
“—And so! Thanks to that, King-san and I 
had the most wondrous, dazzling time 
together~~!!”

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
All of this is thanks to Vivlos-san's... 
...No!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It is all thanks to Tracen Academy's 
"Evangelist of Pampering"~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before anyone realized it, Vivlos had 
earned herself an incredible nickname!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I don't really think I said 
anything that amazing, though?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm just honestly saying what I'm feeling 
and what I want you to do!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I mean, she's someone everyone thinks, 'I 
love her♡' and 'I want to be spoiled by 
her♡' about, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
If it's someone that wonderful, then 
whether they can grant your wish or not, 
I'm sure they'll listen to what you have 
to say.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Then after all, I shouldn't hide my 
feelings out of embarrassment or brush 
them off out of hesitation—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Just because you love them, you ought to 
spoil them! I'm sure they'd be thrilled 
too♡"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
What about you, Trainie? Do you dislike it 
when I cling to you?
choice_data_list:
Not at all. It makes me want to help you 
even more!

Whether we can make them all come true 
might depend on our stamina...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I see! In that case, I shall 
unhesitatingly lean on you with all my 
might from now on!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, me too! And so, Trainy-poo~—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Wanna go get some Hachimi together after 
training~? ...Ehe♡

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, oh my! What wonderful resolve! To 
intend to fulfill them all from the very 
start!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, Trainy, you're so sweet♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
There are sooo many things I wanna do with 
you, Trainie! Let's do eveeeery single 
one♡
